title: Grandma Zuzu's Big Party
pages: A party to plan
Hello, captain! I'm Grandma Zuzu. My grandson Bix turns ten tomorrow, and I'm throwing him the biggest party this side of the galaxy!
Oh dear, oh dear
But I have nothing ready! I need star-berries for the cake, sparkle candles that fizz, and a robot band that can really boogie.
Off you zoom
It's all paid for. Just fly to each planet and pick it up. I've marked them on your star map. Off you zoom, dear!
Party time!
You did it! Look at Bix's face! The cake is purple, the candles are fizzing, and the robot band won't stop dancing.
Thank you, dear
Here's your reward, captain, and a slice of cake for the trip. You're welcome at my table any time!

title: Commander Vex and the Rust Raiders
pages: Trouble in the garden
Captain, Commander Vex of the Star Navy. Pirates called the Rust Raiders are circling a peaceful garden planet. The people there grow flowers, not lasers.
A brave trader
My fleet is stuck on the far side of the galaxy. I need you to chase off three pirate ships. I'll lend you a Navy laser for the job.
Stand your ground
I've marked where each pirate ship is waiting. If they win a fight, don't worry. Mend your ship, come back and try again.
Petals in the sky
The Rust Raiders have fled! The garden planet is safe, and everyone is throwing flower petals into the sky for you.
The Navy thanks you
Please accept the Navy's thanks and this reward. The laser goes back to the Navy, but your courage stays with you.

title: Professor Sprocket's Runaway Robots
pages: Gone without asking
Oh, thank goodness, a captain! I'm Professor Sprocket. My four helper robots, Beep, Boop, Clank and Fizz, have run away on holiday. Without asking!
Where did they go?
Beep went sunbathing on a desert planet. Boop is splashing on a water world. Clank is exploring a mine. And Fizz went to see the fireworks, of course.
Handle with care
Each robot needs one hold in your ship. Pick them all up and bring them home. Be gentle with Clank. He gets space sick.
Home sweet home
All four home, safe and sound! Beep has a tan, Boop is dripping, Clank needs a lie down, and Fizz won't stop talking about sparkles.
A present for you
Here's your reward, captain. And Beep made you this. It's a drawing of you. Well, Beep thinks it's you.

title: Dr Nettle and the Sneezles
pages: Achoo!
Achoo! Excuse me, captain. I'm Dr Nettle. The Sneezles has spread all over my planet, and everyone is sneezing bubbles. Even the mayor!
Empty shelves
I need Medicine and fresh Water, and I've run right out. You'll have to buy them at a market, but I'll pay much more than you spend.
Bubbles to the roof
Your quest list shows where to buy them and today's prices. Please hurry back, before the bubbles reach the roof!
Bless you, captain
The sneezing has stopped! Well, nearly. The mayor still does a tiny bubble now and then. He says it makes him feel fancy.
A tidy profit
Here's what I promised, captain, and a little extra. You saved the day, and you made a tidy profit too!

title: Lumi the Little Star Whale
pages: Look out the window!
Captain, look out your window! That's Lumi, a baby star whale. She swam off chasing comets and can't find her family. I'm Ranger Kai. Can you help?
A trail of stardust
Star whales leave trails of glowing stardust. Lumi's family left clues on planets across the galaxy. Each clue says where to go next.
Follow the clues
Read the clue, find the planet on your star map, and Lumi will follow your ship. Stuck? Tap Show me, and I'll light it up.
Together again
There they are! Lumi's whole family, singing so deep the planets hum. Lumi zooms straight into a giant hug with her mum.
A glowing gift
The star whales left you a gift, a tiny whale made of starlight that shimmers when you're near. And here's a reward from the Ranger Service. Well done!
